en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Muhammad Bin Abdullah, from his father, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Dawood Al Nahdy, 
(It has been narrated) from Ali son of Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘He<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘We (Imams<sup>asws</sup>) are equal in the knowledge and the bravery, and with regards to the Grants, it is in accordance with what we<sup>asws</sup> are Commanded (by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>)’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Abdallah has narrated from his father from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Dawud al-Nahdi from Al,i ibn Ja‘far who has narrated the following from abu al-Hassan.
“In knowledge and courage we all are equal. In benefaction and grants we do to the degree we are commanded.”
